name: Action-as-transition
description: An object performs the verb and the verb moves the film (scissors cut the timeline and that is the cut).

recipe.build: Model or sprite animation for 0.6 s; at the contact frame cut or reveal the next scene behind the split halves.

use_when: Where the product verb can be literal (cut, drop, send, share, tap).
avoid: Do not use if the verb is abstract.
